thread:
ben: Noticed something odd after the canary roll: service /v1/generate p50 improved ~18% but p99 jumped ~35% for eu-central over the last 45m. dashboard: https://console/redwood/d/latency-eu
tae: Which view? per-instance, per-region rollup, or endpoint summary?
ben: endpoint summary → rollup mode=merged-percentiles. per-instance medians look steady. tails from a few instances spiking.
izzy: quick guess: are we mixing in the warmup synthetic job? we run a lightweight warmup that hits the new route with very low latency. If those numbers get merged incorrectly they can drag the median down while a real tail remains.
sre-lucy: our merging pipeline stores t-digests per-storage-shard. on read we merge digests and use total_sample_count to weight. however there was a change last week where alias shards for newly-created routes are materialized with count=null briefly.
ben: I pulled the raw manifest for the window. found alias shards with sample_count="0" and content_digest present. they were included in the merge list.
tea: typo — tae: If sample_count=="0" we should ignore, but legacy code treats missing/zero as 1 to avoid divide-by-zero. that would give tiny fast shards undue influence.
ben: Repro steps I used (local): create two digests: big_slow (10k samples, long tail) and tiny_fast (10 samples, low latency), and include a zero-count digest in the merge list. merged-percentiles showed p50 drop and p99 inflate vs true combined sample percentiles.
izzy: that's a classic weighting bug. Suggestion: 1) change merge to explicitly skip shards with sample_count<=0; 2) add validation in alias creation to never persist shard rows with count<=0; 3) add e2e test covering merging with alias shards.
metric-bot: alert: canary-rollout routing-policy eu -> started 07:04 UTC, warmup-job active :warning:
sre-lucy: also add a console flag to show synthetic-sample-rate per-endpoint so dashboard panels can opt-out of merged-mode when synthetic rate > 0.5%. small ops change but helps debug.
ben: I temporarily switched the eu endpoint panel back to raw-sample aggregation. that removed the discrepancy in charts.
tea: I'll open a small PR to change merge behaviour (skip zero/negative counts) + unit tests. ETA 3h.
izzy: I'll file infra ticket to ensure warmup job sets synthetic=true and that ingestion rejects unlabeled warmup requests.
sre-lucy: action list:
- tae: PR to ignore zero-count digests on merge + tests (ETA 3h)
- ben: attach raw sample ids and before/after screenshots to issue #10901
- izzy: infra enforcement for warmup tagging (follow-up)
- console: add synthetic-rate chart + panel guidance (ETA EOD)
ben: note for runbooks: when you see p50 and p99 move in opposite directions after a rollout, consider synthetic-warmup + merge-weighting as a suspect. small checklist in the incident template would save time.
tea: opened PR #2319 and linked the reproduction harness in the description.
ben: thanks. watching p99 for next 30m. :eyes:
